newsitem.title: MACEDONIA: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.
newsitem.headline: MACEDONIA STOCK TURNOVER, VOLUME RISE.

text.p: Turnover and traded volume rose at Thursday's session of the Macedonian Stock Exchange, the exchange said.
Total turnover rose to 774,965 denars from 45,140 denars with 514 shares changing hands, up from 48 at the previous trading on Tuesday.
Alkaloid joint stock company traded on the third floor, where unlisted firms trade, selling 231 shares at 1,070 denars, unchanged from Tuesday's close but well below par of 91 marks.
A total of 283 Gradski Targovski Centar stocks sold on the first floor at 1,865 denars, unchanged from Tuesday but below par of 2,664 denars.
Listed companies trade in two floor sessions. The exchange trades twice a week. ($1=41.53 denars; 1DEM=26.64 denars) -- Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-981 4145
